title: AccessStep Dataset Public Data Package for AccessStairNet
description: Public de-identified data package supporting the manuscript AccessStairNet: A Mobile Deep Learning Inspection Tool for Human-Centered Accessibility Assessment of Steps and Thresholds in Elderly Home Environments. The package includes annotation schema, aggregate class distribution, model-performance summary, and deployment latency summary. Raw images from private elderly residential environments are not included.
